scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/runner-pi build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/runner-pi build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @ling-stack/runner-pi build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test test/*.test.mjs
